# Architecture

How ProjectBEA is actually put together. Every claim here is anchored to a file so it can be checked against the code rather than trusted.

## The shape of it

main.py wires the command line to the brain. The brain holds one sliding window of context, one loop that reads it, and the skills that act on it.
